video:video.video:title: How a request travels through keepmum
video:video.video:description: A request from a coding agent goes through keepmum on a Mac: secrets are detected and masked, the request is sent with placeholders only, and the real values are restored in the answer. A Codex script that reads a token itself has it withheld before an MCP tool gets it. Then what happens when a check flags a turn, and how you review it before it goes. 110 seconds, no sound.

video:video.video:title: A tour of the keepmum app
video:video.video:description: The keepmum app on a Mac, on preview data: the menu bar panel, the live Overview, Logs, a sample sent along the Protection map, and the review of a flagged turn. 58 seconds, no sound.
